response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive senior-level software development experience with a strong focus on open-source projects and modern tech stacks. While his technical expertise and leadership in development align well with the role, his German language proficiency is below the required C1 level, and his experience in IT architecture and strategic client advisory is less explicitly documented.
strengths: Proven track record in senior software development roles with exposure to full-stack, AI, and DevOps tooling.
Strong open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective) and expertise in Linux/Unix environments.
Demonstrated mentorship and knowledge-sharing through workshops, talks, and community engagement.
concerns: German language proficiency is listed as 'Basic,' falling short of the C1 requirement.
Limited explicit evidence of high-level IT architecture or technical project management leadership.
Experience in client-facing advisory roles (e.g., security, compliance) is not prominently highlighted.
